assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and key areas are provisional constraints inferred from public announcement text; they are not official redlines, approval bases, or precise area bases.
assumptions.impact: All area-derived metrics will be recomputed once official polygons are published; content scoring is not blocked by this organizer-side data gap.

assumptions.statement: Historical facts (the Jing-Zhang Railway Photographic Record, Zhan Tianyou's biography, railway surveying history) and classical quotations (The Doctrine of the Mean, The Analects, Record on Learning, Bowu Zhi, etc.) are used only for cultural narrative, naming, and methodology framing; they are not planning, regulatory, or engineering evidence.
assumptions.impact: If any quoted historical fact is challenged, the narrative paragraph will be revised to cite the authoritative public source; no planning conclusion depends on these references.

assumptions.statement: All ten scenario cards and three industrial test scenarios are conceptual proposals for professional teams to deepen; none is described as an approved or operating arrangement.
assumptions.impact: Scenario metrics are proposed design targets subject to feasibility, licensing, and operational studies; no commitment is implied.

assumptions.statement: No fabricated photos, GPS surveys, interviews, enterprise lists, investment figures, or government commitments are used; all external data is from public or cleared sources and registered in sources.json.
assumptions.impact: Claims not reproducible from registered sources are downgraded to to-be-verified items.
